item.description:
### What's New
- Added live download progress with downloaded and total sizes to install, adopt, and update controls - Added passive operation status for individual, concurrent, and Update All tasks - Added detection and safe adoption for apps installed through the App Store, installer packages, or outside Homebrew - Added Recently Installed sorting for installed apps and made it the default
### Improvements
- Improved Adopt and Updates ordering to default to Name A–Z - Improved download progress with clear phase transitions, stable text, and smoother movement
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed same-named apps showing incorrect Adopt actions by resolving ownership through bundle identity - Fixed external apps in localized or nested application folders not being recognized
